description: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. Coverage: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cross-border railway lines 09/2015; Cross-border railway lines Luxembourg-France in 2026; Cross-border railway lines France-Germany in 2026; Cross-border railway lines France-Germany in 2022. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
